name: F

args.name: pi
args.description: Equilibrium frequencies, keyed by alphabet symbol

title: The +F frequency model
description: Attaches equilibrium frequencies to an exchangeability matrix. Off-diagonal rates are proportional to s(i,j) * pi[j], where s is the exchangeability matrix. The resulting rate matrix is scaled to have mean substitution rate 1. For codon alphabets, the rate is measured per nucleotide site.
